deadline.value: Application deadline is January 15; later applications are considered on a rolling basis.
deadline.quote: Application deadline: January 15th. Applications received after this date will be considered on a rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: The mathematics GRE subject test is optional; other evidence of ability is also accepted.
gre_subject.quote: In addition to the above requirements, applicants may submit other evidence indicating the ability to pursue an advanced degree in mathematics (such as the GRE subject test in mathematics).

gre_general.value: The general GRE is not accepted as part of the application.
gre_general.quote: Scores for the general GRE are not accepted as part of the application.

supervisor.value: The department's pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Most PhD students are supported by a teaching assistantship.
funding.quote: Most PhD students in the mathematical sciences are supported by a teaching assistantship.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is needed by enrollment; a bachelor's in mathematics is not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for a Master's or a Ph.D. degree must have a Bachelor's degree by time of their enrollment.

notes: Option 1 (research) and Option 2 (non-traditional, college teaching) PhD tracks. The department's Master of Science in Data Science is not a PhD.
name: Mathematical Sciences (PhD)
